walkthroughs.body_html:
Two main cold environments:

• Polar — Antarctica and Arctic ice; almost no plants
• Tundra — treeless; mosses, lichens, grasses; permafrost below

Both have extreme cold and low precipitation.

Cold environments share:

• Average winter temps below -30°C
• Very low precipitation (often <250 mm/yr)
• Short growing season (~50 days)
• 24h darkness/light seasonally

Effectively cold deserts.

Cold environments are fragile because:

• Slow plant growth = slow recovery
• Permafrost melts if disturbed
• Few species — simple food webs
• Slow nutrient cycling

Damage can last decades.
